metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Neuroscan system with 64 electrodes at a sampling frequency of 1000 Hz. Recordings included resting state conditions (eyes closed and eyes open) and continuous EEG during MOBA gameplay. Event markers were coded to identify specific in-game events: kills (13), deaths (14), game start (66), game failure (444), and game victory (666).
